Name: Canyons

Params.Name: NoiseAlgorithm
Params.Label: Noise Algorithm
Params.Description: Chooses the pattern used to break up canyon walls, floors, and transitions.

Params.Name: NoiseScale
Params.Label: Noise Scale
Params.Description: Sets the size of the breakup carried across the canyon walls and floor.
Params.Tooltip: Higher values pack more variation into the canyon.

Params.Name: NoiseSeed
Params.Label: Noise Seed
Params.Description: Rearranges canyon wall and floor variation while preserving the canyon form.
Params.Tooltip: Use this to try a different canyon layout without changing its scale.

Params.Name: NoiseWarp
Params.Label: Noise Warp
Params.Description: Bends the canyon sampling path to make walls and floors less uniform.
Params.Tooltip: Increase it for more winding, irregular canyon variation.

Params.Name: NoiseJitter
Params.Label: Noise Jitter
Params.Description: Offsets cellular feature points that shape canyon breakup.
Params.Tooltip: Only affects Gabor, Voronoi, and Worley; it changes cell placement in the canyon detail.

Params.Name: Strength
Params.Description: Scales the overall height amplitude of the generated shape.
Params.Tooltip: Adjust the overall strength of this base shape.

Params.Name: Scale
Params.Description: Controls the scale of the coordinate space used by the shape.
Params.Tooltip: Higher values generally create smaller, more frequent features.

Params.Name: Width
Params.Label: Canyon Width
Params.Description: Controls the width of the main canyon bands.
Params.Tooltip: Increase width for broader canyon regions.

Params.Name: Depth
Params.Description: Controls how deeply the generated feature cuts into the terrain.
Params.Tooltip: Increase depth for a stronger depression or relief.

Params.Name: Waviness
Params.Description: Controls how much the main feature meanders or bends.
Params.Tooltip: Increase waviness for more winding feature paths.

Params.Name: Octaves
Params.Description: Controls how many noise octaves contribute to the shape.
Params.Tooltip: More octaves add finer detail and increase generation cost.

Params.Name: Seed
Params.Description: Selects the deterministic random pattern used by the generator.
Params.Tooltip: Change the seed to create a different reproducible layout.

Params.Name: Offset
Params.Description: Translates the sampling coordinates without changing the shape's scale.
Params.Tooltip: Use the offset to move through the procedural field.

Params.Name: Rotation
Params.Description: Rotates the shape's sampling coordinates around the terrain center.
Params.Tooltip: Use rotation to change the direction of directional features.

Description: Generates a canyons-style procedural base shape with controls for its main form and variation.
